arxiv-2208-07958.title: Detail or uncertainty? Applying global sensitivity analysis to strike a balance in energy system models Journal: Computers & Chemical Engineering
arxiv-2208-07958.creator: Maria Yliruka, Stefano Moret, Nilay Shah
arxiv-2208-07958.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Maria Yliruka, Stefano Moret, Nilay Shah. Energy systems modellers often resort to simplified system representations and deterministic model formulations ( i.e. , not considering uncertainty) to preserve computational tractability. However, reduced levels of detail and neglected uncertainties can both lead to sub-optimal system designs. In this paper, we present a novel method that quantitatively compares the impact of detail and uncertainty to guide model development and help prioritisation of the limited computational resources.

uslaw-cfr-t21-s886-1250.description: Code of Federal Regulations, Title 21 (Food and Drugs), Part 886 (Ophthalmic Devices). Text from the eCFR as of 2026-10-26 (unofficial editorial compilation; the official edition is the annual CFR). (a) Identification. A euthyscope is a device that is a modified AC-powered or battery-powered ophthalmoscope (a perforated mirror device intended to inspect the interior of the eye) that projects a bright light encompassing an arc of about 30 degrees onto the fundus.
